name: Hacked Sixth Battlegroup Package
desc: At one point contained the design specifications for the ships used by the Sixth Battlegroup, has since been hacked to solely produce a refit of the Falcon (VI) by a shortsighted pirate. This blueprint package was likely lost during the changeover before The Collapse. Stored on a Domain-Era Datachip, a highly secure form of data transfer often employed by the Domain Admiralty, it was intended to be physically moved by dedicated packet ships.

name: Planetkiller
desc:
A specialized warhead capable of sundering a world. Operating principles are only dimly understood and are thought to involve utilizing the world's spin and some form of resonance.

This one is safed and requires authorization codes, possibly long-lost, to become anything more than a complicated, but completely inert piece of machinery.

name: Frictionless NMC-000
desc:
An anomalous crystalline material acquired in extremely limited quantities during fringe mining operations on Maddie. Designation Frictionless NMC-000, the substance was formed in the radiation of a red pulsar and is iridescent like the shell of an arthropod-analog.

Considered a chronohazard, it is capable of demonstrating novel temporal properties, inverting the effect of relativity within its sphere of influence with an effect proportional to mass.

name: Dead Alpha Core
desc:
Once the physical soul of a fearsome alien intelligence, this alpha core is now an inert and very complicated bundle of circuitry and interfacing conduits. The alpha-level AI that was housed within this core and designated Ochre Pendragon has been declared "mind-dead" after an encounter with the entity known as Omega, or more accurately, a file sent from Omega via an extradimensional commlink.

An alpha can create art which perfectly simulates human pathos. Ochre Pendragon claimed to have been taught to write poetry by another AI, Amaranth Heuristic, whom seemingly filled some kind of parental role.

name: Volturnian Lobster Eggs
desc:
A clutch of volturnian lobster eggs, stored in finely tuned cryosleep.  

In an adequately controlled environment, this initial population can be rapidly increased and eventually released into the wider natural oceanic ecosystem, allowing for industrial scale lobster trawling on ocean worlds. A genetically encoded failsafe in accordance with the Domain Invasive Species Proliferation Act causes volturnian lobsters to lose fertility within a generation in the wild.
